Based on research conducted in August 2026, here are the publicly available API rate limits and pricing tiers for The Odds API.

### API Rate Limits

The Odds API employs a credit-based usage system rather than a simple request-per-minute counter for its primary limits. However, there is a hard technical rate limit on concurrent requests to prevent server overload.

*   **Technical Rate Limit:** The API enforces a limit of **30 requests per second** on paid usage plans. If this limit is exceeded, the API returns an HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) error. Users are advised to space out requests and implement retry logic with exponential backoff if they encounter this error [the-odds-api.com](https://the-odds-api.com/liveapi/guides/v4/api-error-codes.html).
*   **Usage Credits:** Actual access to data is governed by "usage credits." Each API call deducts a specific number of credits from your monthly quota based on the complexity of the request (e.g., the number of betting markets and bookmaker regions requested). For example, requesting odds for one sport, one region, and one market counts as 1 credit. Requesting multiple markets or regions multiplies this cost [the-odds-api.com](https://the-odds-api.com/manage/faqs.html).
*   **Monitoring:** Users can track their remaining credits via HTTP response headers: `x-requests-remaining`, `x-requests-used`, and `x-requests-last` [the-odds-api.com](https://the-odds-api.com/liveapi/guides/v4/api-error-codes.html).

### Pricing Tiers (2026)

The Odds API offers a self-serve free tier and several paid monthly subscription plans. Pricing is public and billed automatically each month on the anniversary of the subscription start date [the-odds-api.com](https://the-odds-api.com/manage/faqs.html).

| Plan Type | Monthly Cost | Monthly Credit Allowance | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Starter (Free)** | $0 | 500 credits | Includes access to live/upcoming odds, most bookmakers, and all betting markets. Historical odds may be restricted or cost more credits [apibetting.com](https://www.apibetting.com/providers/the-odds-api). |
| **Basic Paid** | ~$30 | 20,000 credits | Entry-level paid tier for higher volume applications [apibetting.com](https://www.apibetting.com/providers/the-odds-api). |
| **High Volume** | ~$249 | 15,000,000 credits | Top-tier plan for enterprise-level usage [apibetting.com](https://www.apibetting.com/providers/the-odds-api). |

*Note: The exact credit cost per request varies. A standard request for live/upcoming odds costs 1 credit per market/region combination. Historical data requests typically cost more credits and are only available on paid plans [the-odds-api.com](https://the-odds-api.com/liveapi/guides/v4/api-error-codes.html).*

### Key Constraints & Best Practices

1.  **No Websockets:** The API operates via REST polling. There is no websocket or streaming delivery, which may impact latency-sensitive in-play betting applications [apibetting.com](https://www.apibetting.com/providers/the-odds-api).
2.  **Historical Data:** Access to historical odds is restricted to paid usage plans. Free tier users cannot access historical endpoints [the-odds-api.com](https://the-odds-api.com/liveapi/guides/v4/api-error-codes.html).
3.  **Optimization:** To minimize credit usage and avoid rate limits, developers should:
    *   Combine multiple markets and regions into a single API call rather than making separate calls for each.
    *   Cache responses from endpoints that change infrequently, such as `/sports` and `/events` [the-odds-api.com](https://the-odds-api.com/guide/rate-limit.html).
    *   Avoid sending requests at exactly 30 requests per second, as network variability can cause bursts that trigger 429 errors. It is recommended to stay below this limit [the-odds-api.com](https://the-odds-api.com/guide/rate-limit.html).

All pricing and credit allowances are subject to change, but the above figures reflect the publicly documented structure as of mid-2026. Users can monitor their usage and upgrade subscriptions via the accounts portal [the-odds-api.com](https://the-odds-api.com/liveapi/guides/v4/api-error-codes.html).
